Parallel loop binding compression suture of the lower uterus during cesarean section
cohort: 124 patients with pernicious placenta previa complicated with placenta increta or percreta
finding: Parallel loop binding compression suture during cesarean section for pernicious placenta previa with placenta increta effectively reduced operative time, blood loss, and blood transfusion requirements without increasing adverse neonatal outcomes compared to traditional figure-of-eight sutures.
mod_finding: Parallel loop binding compression suture was associated with reduced operative time and blood loss during cesarean section.
